results.title: 10 Best Focus Bear Alternatives 2026 (Free Options) | AI Compass
results.content:
Tiimo — Tiimo is a visual planner built for ADHD and autistic students that uses AI to break tasks into manageable steps and turn to-dos into a clear, time-blocked day.
 Saner.ai — Saner.ai is an AI personal assistant designed for ADHD users that captures messy notes, surfaces what matters, and turns scattered thoughts into organized tasks.
 TickTick — TickTick combines task management, a built-in Pomodoro timer, habit tracking, and calendar views in one cross-platform app. Students manage all assignments and study habits without switching between separate apps. The Pomodoro integration lets you start a focused study sprint directly from a task, tracking how many sessions each assignment required over time. [...] Brain.fm — Brain.fm generates AI music specifically engineered to drive neural entrainment that promotes sustained attention, relaxation, or sleep based on acoustic features tested in neuroscience research. Students report more consistent deep focus compared to regular music or silence. The Focus mode is particularly effective for the first 20 minutes of a study session when transitioning into deep work is hardest.
 Goblin Tools — Goblin Tools is a collection of simple AI-powered tools designed specifically to help neurodiverse students, particularly those with ADHD, manage executive function challenges. Its Magic To-Do feature breaks any task description into small, concise action steps. The Tone checker helps students gauge how an email or message might be interpreted before sending. [...] Reclaim.ai — Reclaim.ai automatically schedules habits and tasks into the gaps of a student's calendar, protecting time for studying, gym, and personal projects. Students set a weekly study goal and Reclaim fills available time slots adaptively, rescheduling around new commitments. The Google Calendar integration means it works within existing workflows without friction.
 Endel — Endel generates personalized soundscapes that adapt in real time to a student's circadian rhythm, weather, heart rate, and time of day to support the current activity goal. The Focus mode adjusts intensity based on the time relative to natural energy peaks, while the Sleep mode guides the transition to restful sleep. Its Apple Watch integration uses live biometric data to refine the audio output.

Focus Bear vs Focusmo: An Honest Comparison for ADHD Mac Users (2026)

Both Focus Bear and Focusmo get recommended to the exact same person: a Mac user with ADHD who's sick of "just focus harder" advice and wants an app that actually does something. But the two apps solve that problem from opposite ends. Focus Bear wants to run your whole day — routines, habits, breaks, blocking, across every device you own. Focusmo wants to run your next focus session — quietly, from the Mac menu bar, wired into the task list you already keep. [...] ## Focus Bear: The Whole-Day Routine Coach

Focus Bear is built explicitly for AuDHDers — its own word for people with ADHD and autism — and its guiding philosophy is "make healthy habits the path of least resistance." It's less a focus timer and more an operating system for your day. It walks you through a morning routine, nudges you into work, enforces breaks with guided stretches, blocks distractions, and closes you out with an evening wind-down.

What it does well: [...] Not a task-manager hub. Focus Bear is largely self-contained and routine-centric. It isn't designed to plug into whatever task manager you already live in, so if your tasks are in Things 3 or Todoist, you're working alongside Focus Bear rather than through it.
